description: Found by the 2026-08-20 full lib-diff re-read of #152: batch.ex/batching.ex still set finalized_at, but nothing in lib reads it (only tests do). PR #167's commit message listed it among removed write-only fields - the deletion silently didn't happen. Remove the field and adjust the tests to assert observable behavior instead, or name a real reader.
title: Trim: Batch.finalized_at is write-only in lib; #167's message claimed removal
